text:
maya: quick dump — ran cross-cloud hotstart & coldstart benches for Mosaic and Mistral 7B. comparing A100 vs H100 across eu-west/us-west. metrics: prefill_p50, prefill_p99, decode_p50, decode_p99, tokens_per_sec, $/1M. attaching inline sample table.

alex: nice. can you share the exact config? batch sizes, seq len, kv cache warm?

maya: seq=1024, batch=1 for p99 sim (real traffic mimic). kv_hit simulated at 30% using prefix cache. quant=Q8_0 on both. kernels: default auto-select; saw fallbacks on A100 in us-west.

devin: interesting — did you force cutoff kernel policy? was there any kernel fallthrough to CPU?

maya: no CPU. we saw kernel selection fallthrough from fast-attn -> slower tiled on A100 at long seq >1536. H100 stuck with fast-attn up to 2048.

liam: what's the cost delta $/1M tokens?

maya: table:
```
model, gpu, region, prefill_p50_ms, prefill_p99_ms, decode_p50_ms, decode_p99_ms, tps, $/1M
mosaic7b, H100, eu-west, 40, 95, 6, 32, 18, 38
mosaic7b, A100, eu-west, 62, 145, 9, 52, 12, 60
mistral7b, H100, us-west, 44, 110, 7, 36, 17, 42
mistral7b, A100, us-west, 68, 175, 11, 68, 11, 70
```

maya: these are observed with continuous batching enabled. $/1M uses infra cost model (gpu-hour + overhead) tuned to committed price; includes prefix cache savings.

alex: wow H100 is consistently cheaper per token here. Did you try q4_0 quant for mistral? any quality regressions?

maya: quick eval on 200 prompts: Q8_0 vs Q4_0 on mistral showed minor rouge drop ~0.6, acceptably small for rr use-cases. will run larger eval set next.

devin: kernel note — for A100, try forcing `--kernel-policy=prefer-tiled` for prefill, keeps memory locality but ups latency; might reduce p99 spikes due to fallback.

liam: region note — cross-zone increases p99 by ~5-8ms if model shard redispatch occurs. did you pin model to same AZ?

maya: pinned for eu-west tests. us-west was mixed due to capacity constraints. crosszone looked worse in cheap-skus.

infra-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/3300001111/hotstart-metrics.csv :white_check_mark:

alex: ok next actions: (1) larger eval on Q4_0, (2) run A100 forced kernel policy and compare, (3) size sim for burst qps to compute reserved sku needs.

maya: on it. will post follow-up with csv and charts. thanks :thumbsup:

liam: +1, also link to the billing model used pls.

maya: billing model: internal doc link https://redwood.internal/infra/billing/token-econ-v2

devin: noted — good job.
